encoded_aac_measurement.method: Production export decoded the encoded AAC and ran BS.1770 loudness/true-peak metering. This audit read its saved result; no new decode.

timing_interpretation: Speech-level comparisons use source diarized speech intervals and final planner voiced intervals (derived from take pauses), not whole-line duration ratios. Uncovered source time is a timing mismatch, not proof of omitted meaning or inaudible final mix. No ASR or native-listener confirmation.

waveform_guard_evidence.limitation: Selected natural waveforms are structurally checked for empty, malformed, nonfinite and numerical silence by production code; final traces do not contain a per-line positive QA certificate. Candidate failure costs can be restored history and are not current-run failure counts.
